data.narrative:
Grain Weevil is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Chad Johnson and Ben Johnson, having raised $3.5M to date. The comparable universe in Robotics & Manufacturing consists of 9 private peers (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ), though peer-set density remains constrained at this early stage.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and provides the primary valuation anchor. Using total raised ($3.5M) as a proxy base and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $9M. The Peer-Median method is not applicable due to insufficient datapoints; while 10 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 meet the narrow filters of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier valuation, making a peer-median cross-check unreliable at this stage.

The triangulated analysis, constrained to one applicable method, supports a valuation range of $7M (low) to $10M (high), with a median of $9M. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x step-up multiplier for this particular founder team and technology vertical, execution risk inherent to Seed stage, and the absence of a second independent method to validate the stage-progression result. A closer peer set would materially strengthen conviction in this range.
